name: scene-mosaico
title: Mosaico
description: The cement-tile floor of an old Goan balcão, seen from above: one Truchet tile laid in two turns, so the oxide-red bands join into long winding ribbons, worn and chipped under late window light. Now and then a tile lifts and turns and the ribbons re-route, and a small ant walks the pale line down one ribbon, following the new way. In playful, hover or Enter turns a tile and a click re-lays a patch. Dark pages get the same floor at night.
